summary: Reproduced the deterministic chunked-prefill starvation mechanism in the checked-out admission code: a 129-token request with a 128-token chunk and 4096-token truncation alignment returns OTHER on repeated admission attempts without consuming budget or becoming runnable. Added scheduler initialization validation that rejects only positive chunk sizes below the selected deterministic prefill alignment. Unlike the existing upstream candidate PR, the guard preserves chunked_prefill_size=-1, which disables chunking. Added failing-before/passing-after coverage and independent equality, larger-chunk, disabled-chunking, non-deterministic, and backend-without-alignment boundaries.

tests.what_was_measured: Before the source fix, the new regression failed because chunked_prefill_size=128 was accepted with deterministic Triton alignment 4096. Raw output: reports/j-9d01654c8a51/raw/failing_before.txt
After the source fix, scheduler validation and its boundary cases passed: 13 tests, 544 subtests. Raw output: reports/j-9d01654c8a51/raw/passing_after.txt

Final focused suite passed 42 tests and 556 subtests, including two repeated no-progress admissions for the reported 129/128/4096 boundary and independent scheduler configuration boundaries. Raw output: reports/j-9d01654c8a51/raw/focused_tests_final.txt
No whitespace errors in the patch. Raw output: reports/j-9d01654c8a51/raw/diff_check.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: No model or kernel execution was used. The assigned GPU is an AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950), whereas the report concerns NVIDIA L40S/CUDA Triton. The defect and correction are in scheduler configuration/admission control and were validated deterministically without claiming cross-architecture serving equivalence.

remaining_limitations: No full HTTP server reproduction was performed on the reporter's NVIDIA L40S/CUDA/Triton stack; that hardware and the reporter's model weights were unavailable.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture referenced in amdpilot-org/sglang PR649 was not present in the prepared workspace, so no transport/engine smoke is claimed.
The tests reproduce the exact scheduler admission starvation mechanism and validate startup rejection, but do not establish model semantic accuracy or distributed behavior.
